posts.text:
I haven't been a big fan of the "in hours of work" measure in general, like for groceries. I like it for rent because:
- linkage between wages and housing prices at state level
- issue of deflating shelter by CPI which is a third shelter
- big enough of a single item that it tracks
posts.summary: Prefers wages-to-housing metric over hours-of-work measure

posts.text:
I think a more micro vibes discussion, after decades of general macro vibes and a current obsession with macro frames, is important.

Both because macro variables are going to miss what's happening in this moment, and the political tripwires are also different in this world. 4/4
